headline: SpaceX credits AI business for strong third-quarter earnings growth
summary: SpaceX reported strong third-quarter results, crediting its AI-focused business for a revenue jump to $14.6 billion, up 161% year-over-year, with net income reaching $4.4 billion. Its Space division posted a $7 million operating loss even as the company's AI and connectivity businesses drove overall growth.
